kidsPolicy.rule: FREE of charge (No separate seat; infant carried by parents).
Child category — 50% of package cost with a dedicated jumper / folding seat.

refundPolicy.condition: Cancellation Less Than 3 Days Before Departure

refundPolicy.refund: No refund if a traveler leaves the trip after departure for any personal reason.
If a trip is discontinued due to unavoidable natural circumstances, remaining amount refunded per actual calculation.
FULL 100% Refund if cancelled a day prior due to government directives or management issues.
Approved refunds are credited within 5 – 6 working days.

bookingPolicy: Select your package & receive a free confirmed quotation.
Provide verified member CNIC / ID details.
50% Advance Payment required at least 7 days before departure.
Payment proof/receipt must be shared on Musafir Pakistan official WhatsApp (+92-336-683-2018).
The remaining 50% payment must be cleared 1 day before departure.
If remaining dues are not cleared, tour manager / guide will not permit boarding.
Payments accepted via Online Bank Transfer, Cash at Karachi Head Office or Islamabad Hotel.
EasyPaisa / JazzCash transactions carry 2% additional platform charges.
generalTravelPolicies: Every traveler must carry a valid original CNIC and vaccination card. Married couples must carry a copy of their Marriage Certificate.
Foreign travelers are NOT permitted to join northern tours without a valid No Objection Certificate (NOC) issued by the Government of Pakistan. Must be communicated prior to booking.
Travelers must arrive at the designated pickup point at least 30 minutes before departure and report to the Tour Manager.
Departures may experience delays due to political situations, weather conditions, or highway clearance. Travelers are requested to cooperate with patience.
Weapons, narcotics, alcohol, or illegal substances are strictly prohibited on all Musafir Pakistan trips.
Ethical, respectful behavior towards fellow group members, women, and locals is mandatory. Misconduct will result in immediate cancellation of participation.
Seat selection in group vehicles is NOT allowed. Seating is managed and rotated by the Tour Guide with priority to families and senior citizens.
Each traveler is allowed a maximum of 20 KG luggage and is responsible for managing their personal bags.
Package prices may be revised in the rare event of major fuel price hikes by the government, even after initial reservation.
Sightseeing points may be skipped or altered due to time management, snowfall, or local administration guidelines. Alternatives provided where possible.
packingChecklist: Original CNIC & Marriage Certificate Copy (for couples)
Warm Clothes, Thermal Layers, Heavy Jacket & Woolen Socks
Sunglasses & Sunscreen (High UV in mountain passes)
Compact Body Bag / Daypack for daily items
Emergency Cash in hand (ATMs in northern areas are frequently offline)
Plastic / Zipper Pouches for damp or used laundry
hotelPolicy: Hotel Check-in: 3:00 PM | Hotel Check-out: 12:00 PM.
Early Check-in or Late Check-out is subject to room availability at PKR 1,000 per hour.
Travelers are strictly responsible for their personal valuables and luggage after checkout.
Guests must adhere to hotel management rules and local district administration policies.
In case of extreme weather, electrical, or governmental issues, hotel staff & Musafir team coordinate emergency lodging solutions.
Any extra hotel services (heaters, laundry, special room service orders) must be cleared directly at checkout.
transportPolicy: Vehicles are provided strictly with verified, experienced mountain drivers.
If Transport-Only service is rented: fuel, toll taxes, traffic violation fines, and driver food/stay are the client's responsibility.
Any interior vehicle damage caused by negligence will be charged to the traveler.
Vehicle must be kept clean; otherwise cleaning charges may apply upon return.
Overspeeding, hazardous driving requests, illegal activities, or sub-renting are strictly prohibited.
CNIC copy is mandatory for all transport bookings.
Transport Cancellation: 3 Days Prior — 50% Refund; Less than 3 Days — NO Refund.
Standard Driving Hours: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM. Night travel is subject to driver consent and additional night charges.
ticketsPolicy: Musafir Pakistan does not include train, bus, or air tickets to Islamabad by default city.
Ticket booking concierge service is available upon request with a flat PKR 200 service charge per ticket.
Any ticketing platform or terminal charges are borne by the traveler.
Seats are reserved based on live availability and seat layouts pre-approved by the client.
Confirmed E-tickets are shared via WhatsApp within 24 hours of confirmation.
Musafir Pakistan is not liable for delays, schedule revisions, or cancellations made by airlines, bus terminals, or railways.
Ticket refund or date change rules are strictly governed by the respective carrier authority.
